description:
Revo Uninstaller helps you to uninstall software and remove unwanted programs easily.

Revo Uninstaller Free helps you to uninstall software and remove unwanted programs easily. It first runs the program's built-in uninstaller and then scans for leftover data that may still remain in files, folders, and Windows registry entries. It also cleans history and traces, manages startup programs, and removes Windows apps.
Added - Hunter Mode now fully supports Windows apps
Improved - Helper module security and detection of uninstall processes
Improved - Scanning and safety algorithms for leftovers
Fixed minor bugs
Updated language files
